sources.title: README.md · open-thoughts/OpenThinker-32B at main
sources.snippet: OpenThinker-32B This model is a fine-tuned version of Qwen/Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct on the OpenThoughts-114k dataset. The dataset is derived by distilling DeepSeek-R1 using the data pipeline available on github. More info about the dataset can be found on the dataset card at OpenThoughts-114k dataset.

sources.title: OpenThinker-32B: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview OpenThinker-32B is a fine-tuned 32-billion parameter reasoning model developed by open-thoughts, built on top of Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct and trained on the OpenThoughts-114k dataset. The model uses distilled data from DeepSeek-R1 and operates with a 16k context length, enabling extended reasoning tasks across mathematics, science, and knowledge-based problems.
